name: Hot water
summary: A shower schedule for a shared apartment drawn as the water heater and a curve of hot water left across the morning: everyone's shower is a block on the timeline, the curve dips with each one and refills between, stretches with no hot water turn blue, and tapping the timeline or finding a hot slot books yours.
useWhen: who keeps using all the hot water

dontUseWhen: booking a shared room or space for a whole day

startHour.description: Clock hour the timeline starts at, 0 to 23

tank.description: Minutes of hot shower a full tank gives

refill.description: Tank refill per idle minute, in tenths of a minute (4 means 0.4 min)

usual.description: Default shower length in minutes when someone taps

showers.description: Showers already booked, no overlaps, with what people said in their own words
